loop.observation: Loop refresh dispatch can discover non-workflow refresh commands from multiple command evidence sources that safe GitHub workflow dispatch cannot execute.
loop.hypothesis: Merging fresh command evidence sources and emitting ignored refresh commands as redacted closed-loop candidates lets registry refresh commands and candidate-decision next commands share the same safe dispatch path.
loop.execute: Generate a dispatch plan and optional candidate artifact from one or more loop-refresh command evidence files without shell-evaluating command strings, and verify the sample path with real closed-loop candidate decision command output.
loop.evaluate: The verifier fails on stale source evidence, unsafe workflow command parsing, missing ignored command details, missing repeated command input coverage, missing candidate-decision producer coverage, missing candidate source refs, or missing adoption commands.
loop.retrospective: This keeps workflow dispatch safe while preventing target verifier commands from either loop-registry or candidate-decision evidence from falling back into human memory.
